# Agentic Synth Twin

> Local macOS research prototype for learning and validating a reproducible digital twin of a CLAP synthesizer.

## Canonical documentation

- [Project overview](README.md): hypothesis, human calibration, LOCK principle, roadmap, and scope
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): conceptual chain, boundaries, invariants, and decisions
- [CLAP feasibility](docs/clap-feasibility.md): pinned build, probe evidence, and known upstream limitations
- [Canonical synth state](docs/canonical-synth-state.md): versioned state contract, validation, authority boundaries, and reproduction
- [Deterministic audition](docs/deterministic-audition.md): fixed C3 render contract, WAV evidence, browser playback, and limitations
- [Human A/B probe](docs/human-ab-probe.md): local blinded calibration, SQLite persistence, first pilot judgment, and limitations
- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): repository rules, current milestone boundary, and checks
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): focused PR workflow
- [Security](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting guidance

## Current status

Milestone 4 provides a local blinded A/B app with direct SQLite judgment capture and one completed pilot observation. DSP, synthetic dataset, model, optimization, and LOCK functionality do not exist yet.

- https://github.com/jeremybboy/agentic-synth-twin
